text:
## Creative brief
Plan a ~60-second documentary about Viviana’s book Playful Pottery and what is an important lesson about creativity and kindness the book aims to show.

## Overview & Tone
This 60-second piece takes the viewer on a concise emotional journey from calm, tactile curiosity to an upbeat celebration of creative freedom and radical self-acceptance. We open introspectively on sensory close-ups of pottery before breaking into a vibrant, groove-driven montage that captures Viviana’s core message: letting go of perfectionism and embracing playful, body-positive pottery.

## Story Beats

#### 1. The Hook & Mystery (0:00–0:22) [node: beat_daa2fb72-7411-49c1-9d8b-a636a506c50b]
We open with tactile, enigmatic close-ups of clay work [node: card_9381801a-6af2-41cf-81cd-3e4022401adf] utilizing the opening macro moments of B003C005_240719NB [node: card_9c08b916-b413-443a-b7e8-367d401745c4] (B003C005_240719NB (0.8s–13.5s)) without revealing Viviana's face. Underneath, a soft, ambient score sets a reflective tone [node: card_5a016edd-0d45-434b-8b08-f9df97a00632]. Over these visuals, Viviana’s voiceover delivers her opening hook [node: card_754b2746-5f4a-4aba-81fb-1f59016526e3], tightly edited to remove hesitations and "uhms" as she reflects on how stuffy and colorless traditional pottery books felt. 

At around 0:08, we cut on-camera to Viviana from A001C004_240718BC [node: card_a0c22f29-0daf-4596-ba53-82db2d120a7e] (A001C004_240718BC (37.6s–57.4s)) as she warmly introduces herself and chuckles [node: card_9e2ffd61-496b-44d4-ba43-2f9219be4ab2]. Her spontaneous giggle serves as the audio button to kill the reflective music track. She immediately pivots into her artistic mission—making an accessible, simplified beginner's guide [node: card_4464f89b-0b1a-48ca-a463-271a17beace7]—bridging her A-roll dialogue smoothly into A001C002_240718OR [node: card_15dd07e6-e413-4033-b422-648c283a3d2d] (A001C002_240718OR (14s–25s)). We cut briefly to studio atmosphere in B003C009_240719KG [node: card_684f9e66-4d1d-4231-a786-3ba9b8b610e2] (B003C009_240719KG (9s–12.2s)) to maintain visual momentum; the duplicate sub-clip of B003C005_240719NB [node: card_49afb16a-7c17-4d70-a938-1dc979d482fc] (B003C005_240719NB (0.8s–13.5s)) is left unused to avoid repetitive shot framing before the energy shift.

#### 2. The Philosophy of Flow and Kindness (0:22–0:42) [node: beat_506a43e2-6740-45a6-aaa8-9d8075c3202b]
The cut kicks into gear right as the driving bass and drum groove of `groovy_fun.wav` [node: card_2a4b4afa-a0e0-445f-bb72-b61f84bd1438] (projects/mudwitch-documentary/sound/groovy_fun.wav (use 0.2s–17.4s of the source — real stock audio file, use directly, do not generate a replacement)) drops. Viviana explains her creative philosophy: treating pottery as an open flow where mistakes are welcomed as part of the beauty [node: card_8735d917-65b7-44f0-91d2-b0e1fa95b1d1]. We pull sync dialogue from A001C004_240718BC [node: card_7318301f-697d-4327-a151-5efbaa3dd998] (A001C004_240718BC (98s–107.6s)), trimming off the preliminary "but also" to dive straight into the heart of her statement.

To match her philosophy visually, we establish a seamless two-shot B-roll sequence: we see her hands actively centering and shaping spinning clay from a tight 6-second trim of B003C011_240719YX [node: card_8a732581-1a5e-433a-876e-edc954dffc9e] (B003C011_240719YX (21.5s–99.5s)), butt-cut directly into vibrant brushwork applying multi-colored glaze in B003C006_240719KM [node: card_390400f6-82aa-4760-aa57-f3881b9c4706] (B003C006_240719KM (14.5s–22.077818295629704s)) to physically manifest that sense of creative freedom [node: card_b7944bba-a377-4ee7-b6b9-7d2e24dba462]. We then cross into an extended bite from A001C004_240718BC [node: card_daec3e6a-7237-4423-86bc-cb7ed1c8663e] (A001C004_240718BC (501.6s–521.3s)), supported by cutaway B003C061_240719AN [node: card_b2e88873-f437-4908-8850-809f55ee465f] (B003C061_240719AN (6.5s–13.6s)), bridging her thoughts on kindness directly toward her body-positive mug collection.

#### 3. Creating Chubby Mugs (0:42–1:00) [node: beat_ea4dcdda-9050-4003-9319-6c83e8894cc6]
In the final act, Viviana connects her ceramic forms to body positivity and self-love [node: card_2c0ae7ab-2ddb-4af1-b8c4-a096e6e85c17]. We build a tight dialogue string across A001C004_240718BC [node: card_c0b4baf0-dc4a-441c-85e6-0d4f30265619] (A001C004_240718BC (674.503791990167s–681.4295859895362s)) and [node: card_a77d9851-fa5e-4b02-accf-d674b3e6ffd7] (A001C004_240718BC (693.9s–702.1s)), where she explains how learning to love human curves directly inspired her signature Chubby Mugs and saturated color palette.

Over her words, we run a dynamic showcase montage [node: card_2318874e-0477-4905-8a97-75d0b2e40aed] (B003C017_240719GP (5.2s–8.6s); B003C050_240719XK (7.5s–37.5s); B003C050_240719XK (29.2s–33.9s); B003C050_240719XK (21.5s–25.2s)), cutting across shelf displays of finished ceramics and playful pottery textures. Viviana delivers her concluding thought on embracing creativity without judgment from A001C004_240718BC [node: card_c09b4922-2b2b-44c6-8b76-aafe1dd63304] (A001C004_240718BC (756s–762s)), and we land the video on the hero beauty shot of a finished mug in B003C039_240719DU [node: card_e2584b9c-58c0-4adf-99fd-2cc6759c4ff2] (B003C039_240719DU (7.9s–9.8s)), letting the music ring out cleanly.

## Constraints

- The plan above is the spec — it already made the editorial calls (what to use, what to omit, how to sequence and combine material). Follow the plan's own decisions rather than independently re-deriving them from first principles.
- Track is authoritative for whatever the plan places on a given track. A shot the plan describes as A-Roll must land on the A-Roll track, B-Roll on B-Roll, music on the Music track, and text/graphics on the Text/Graphics track. A card does not count as fulfilled merely because related material appears elsewhere in the timeline on the wrong track.
- Timecodes and durations in the plan are approximate targets, not exact requirements — use editorial judgment on the actual cut points, same as any real edit.
- A Music card whose source names a real file path (marked "real stock audio file") must be added directly with `edit-timeline add-clip <path> --row music --role music` — do not call `/generate music` for it.

## Instructions for tagging

When adding a clip with `edit-timeline add-clip`, attach the corresponding plan node ID using `--node-ids card_<id>` (or `beat_<id>` for a beat-level marker).

If one clip fulfills multiple plan node ids, include all applicable ones.

Only attach a node ID when the clip actually fulfills what the plan describes for it, including its named track. Use the exact node IDs from the plan. Do not invent or modify them.

## Completion requirements

Before finishing, verify against the plan's own decisions, not the original grid.

For each beat, confirm the edit the plan describes was actually realized: the right material landed on the right track, in the intended order, with any transitions/overlaps the plan called out.

For any node id the plan itself named as an intentionally unused alternative or backup, no further action is needed — that was already the plan's own decision, not something to silently reconsider or silently include anyway.

A node id that the plan actively describes using, but that never lands on the corresponding clip, is a real gap — note it and the reason in verification.
